Bash(gh pr create --base develop --title "fix: use Fluid oracle price for XAUT withdrawal validation" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Fixes XAUT withdrawal failures on passkey wallets caused by price discrepancy between frontend \(CoinGecko\) and Fluid''s on-chain oracle
- Frontend now uses Fluid''s oracle price for withdrawal validation, matching what the smart contract uses
- Adds 16 new TDD tests for oracle price integration

## Root Cause
The `EstimateGasExecutionError: Execution reverted for an unknown reason` was happening because:
1. Frontend used CoinGecko prices \(~$5001\) for withdrawal validation
2. Fluid''s on-chain oracle had different prices \(~$4990\)
3. Frontend validation passed but on-chain simulation failed

## Changes
| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/web3/fluid.ts` | Added `oraclePrice` to `FluidVaultData`, `getFluidOraclePrice\(\)`, `convertOraclePriceToUsd\(\)`, `ORACLE_PRICE_DECIMALS` constant |
| `src/hooks/useFluid.ts` | Added `oraclePrice` parameter to `validateWithdrawalAmount`, returns oracle price from hook |
| `src/components/wallet/LoanSimulator.tsx` | Uses `fluid.oraclePrice` for `xautAvailableToWithdraw` calculation |
| `test/lib/web3/fluidOraclePrice.test.ts` | 16 new TDD tests for oracle price integration |

- [x] All 16 new oracle price tests pass
- [x] All 59 existing Fluid-related tests pass \(no regressions\)
- [x] All 1411 tests pass in full test suite
- [x] Build compiles successfully
- [ ] Manual test: XAUT withdrawal on passkey wallet \(requires live testing\)
